reviewer.role: Dedicated window-design advisor and face reviewer

scope: 100 individual face decisions from current measured elevations and controlled source. Not game implementation, perspective approval, professional structural certification or user art acceptance.
method: Initial direct inspection covered all 25 R5 sheets and 100 faces. After the bounded correction batch, all 15 previously revised faces plus the two quiet/open Textile quadrants on the changed sheet were re-inspected. The remaining 83 faces retain exact PNG hashes and measured opening observations. Every updated building floor-axis schedule was separately checked against source openings; canonical room references were traced on both sides. This approval was not inferred from validators.

W-01.title: Reconcile declared building axes with the drawn room stacks

Update stale primaryAxesM, alignmentRule and structural descriptions from actual intended composition; do not merely union every coordinate and claim it is a bearing grid. Keep sound ground openings and floor heights.

W-02.title: Make Textile/Tea one shared upper floor plan
W-02.requiredCorrection: Replace per-face overlapping full-depth room boxes with one canonical room registry shared by opposite faces. Suggested upper room y extents:48.1..53.55 south room,53.75..61.5 central work/sitting hall,61.7..63.9 north room, within actual footprint x extents. Bind front and reverse apertures to those same IDs. Move T_W_FOLDS L1/L2 from 62.4 to 62.8, centering the north room and matching the reverse room/staff axis. Preserve south 50.8 stack. The central hall may have front work light 56.8 and rear sitting gallery 59.29 because each faces a different work/seating end; name that relationship explicitly. Its rear 54.6 work light belongs to that same hall. Remove F_NW/R_S_CAP whole-building duplicate rooms and bind end openings to the actual end rooms. Give floor-specific upper room/bearing/framing axes without moving ground trades.
evidence: T_W_LOOM L1 y48.1..53.55 conflicts with tr-e L1 split52.7.
T_W_DYER L2 y53.75..59 overlaps tt-e L2 y56.1..61.045 as different full-depth rooms.
F_NW and R_S_CAP rooms both span y48.1..63.9.
W-02.closureEvidence: Closed: Textile SOUTH/CENTRAL/NORTH room identities and nonoverlapping bounds are shared by both facades and end returns on both upper floors; north front stack 62.8 with 1.20 m width visually inspected. Central hall names its front working and rear seating ends. Raised ground Tea room is depth-separated from front trades.

W-03.title: Unify Fountain merchant front and Souk reverse rooms
W-03.requiredCorrection: Use one canonical upper room set shared by F_E_LOGGIA and cs-ws: stair/service zone y 32.1..34.6 and reception/workroom y 34.6..38.9, with existing floor heights 4.9/7.9 and shared opening axes 33.1/36.1.
